headerDisplay: Pulse-Eight USB-CEC Apple TV Remote Bridge for Homebridge
footerDisplay: Captures Apple TV Siri Remote HDMI-CEC Volume Up, Volume Down, and Mute presses via cec-client (libcec) and exposes them as native HomeKit StatelessProgrammableSwitch buttons so you can automate any Homebridge device.

name.title: Platform Name
name.description: The name for this platform instance in Homebridge.

_bridge.title: Child Bridge
_bridge.description: Optional Homebridge Child Bridge settings (managed via Bridge Settings in Homebridge UI).

cecClientPath.title: cec-client Executable Path
cecClientPath.description: Path to the libcec cec-client binary (e.g. 'cec-client', '/opt/homebrew/bin/cec-client', or '/usr/bin/cec-client').

portPath.title: Pulse-Eight Serial Port (Optional)
portPath.description: Leave blank to let cec-client auto-detect the Pulse-Eight adapter, or specify an explicit serial device path.

osdName.title: CEC OSD Name
osdName.description: Device name advertised on the HDMI-CEC bus (up to 14 characters).

hdmiPort.title: HDMI Port Number (Optional)
hdmiPort.description: Optional HDMI port number (-p) if cec-client needs an explicit port for your receiver/switch.

holdMode.title: Volume Hold Behavior

oneOf.title: Continuous Repeat (Emit Single Press every 150ms while held)

holdMode.description: How holding Volume Up or Volume Down on the Siri Remote maps to HomeKit StatelessProgrammableSwitch events.

holdDelayMs.title: Hold Threshold Delay (ms)
holdDelayMs.description: Milliseconds a volume button must be held before triggering Long Press or starting repeat ticks.

holdRepeatMs.title: Hold Repeat Interval (ms)
holdRepeatMs.description: Repeat interval in milliseconds when Volume Hold Behavior is set to Continuous Repeat.

holdSafetyMs.title: Hold Safety Timeout (ms)
holdSafetyMs.description: Maximum duration before automatically stopping a hold if a CEC release packet (0x45) is dropped.

rescanIntervalSec.title: Periodic CEC Bus Rescan Interval (seconds)
rescanIntervalSec.description: Optional interval to periodically re-scan the HDMI-CEC bus for newly connected Apple TVs (0 = only scan on startup and unknown device traffic).

devices.title: Apple TV Filters & Overrides (Optional)
devices.description: By default, all Apple TVs found by 'cec-client scan' are exposed automatically. Add entries here only if you want to filter specific Apple TVs or customize their HomeKit names.

logicalAddress.title: CEC Logical Address (Hex)
logicalAddress.description: Match discovered Apple TV by CEC logical address nibble (e.g. '4' for Playback 1, '8' for Playback 2, 'b' for Playback 3).

physicalAddress.title: CEC Physical Address
physicalAddress.description: Match discovered Apple TV by HDMI physical address (e.g. '6.0.0.0').

osdName.title: Discovered CEC OSD Name
osdName.description: Match discovered Apple TV by its CEC OSD string.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Set to false to ignore this Apple TV.
